node.statement: Exact source block decomposition. Because Pi_1,Pi_2 are complementary orthogonal projections in the source C*-algebra, X_jk=Pi_j X Pi_k belongs to S_{Pi_j,Pi_k}, X=sum_jk X_jk, and ||X_jk||<=||X||. Conversely addition reconstructs X, so mu_n is a linear bijection, and max_jk||X_jk|| <= ||X|| <= sum_jk||X_jk|| <=4 max_jk||X_jk||, at every amplification.
